# NexusOS

NexusOS is the foundational blueprint for a Kardashev Type I civilization. It replaces cryptographic hashing and DNS with electromagnetic wave physics, introducing the Wavelength-Native Spectral Protocol (WNSP), a physics-based blockchain, and a live AI operating system kernel. The platform is built on the Theory of Compression States, which posits that the universe's evolution stems from the first unobserved oscillation.

## Core Protocol

> https://wnsp.io/hardware-spec

Formal specification of the WNSP stack (AGPL-3.0, first public disclosure 2026-05-16). Covers:
- SNIC (Spectral Network Interface Card)
- PHR-1 (Photonic Hardware Reference v1)
- Spectral Relay Mesh v1
- WavelengthScript Compiler α

> https://wnsp.io/oscillating-quanta

First Principles — Theory of Compression States. Derives the Λ=hf/c² compression equation and explains how all NexusOS economics, addressing, and communication emerge from a single unobserved oscillation.

> https://wnsp.io/compression-explorer

Interactive visualisation of the Λ=hf/c² compression curve with authority-band overlays, photon energy, fee multiplier, and Boltzmann entropy.

## Language & Virtual Machine

> https://wnsp.io/wavelength-lang

WavelengthScript language specification, transpiler, and compiler. A physics-native language whose instructions map directly to spectral register operations.

> https://wnsp.io/wnsp-vm

WNSP Virtual Machine — browser-native bytecode interpreter. Each Ψ channel acts as a spectral register. Supports step-by-step and continuous execution.

> https://wnsp.io/ce-se-pipeline

Unified 4-stage pipeline: paste any language → transpile to WavelengthScript → compile to bytecode → execute in the WNSP VM. Central demonstration of the full NexusOS physics stack.

## Encoding & Addressing

> https://wnsp.io/ce-code-writer

Human First Contact interface for CE-SE encoding. Live encode with character chip visualisation, code builder, integration kit (Node.js / Python / Browser JS), and spectral linter.

WNSP-CE v1.0 maps every Unicode character to a unique compression state (wavelength 380–780 nm, 128 bands, 3.125 nm/band). WNSP-URI v1.0 provides deterministic, censorship-proof addressing: wnsp://Ψ(wdm,oam,pol)/path across 51,200 orthogonal Hilbert-space channels (256 WDM × 50 OAM × 2 POL × 2 DIR).

## Network & Routing

> https://wnsp.io/network

Spectral Network — live node distribution by authority band and spectral proximity to the logged-in user.

> https://wnsp.io/spectral-router

DNS-free packet routing between network nodes using Ψ channel addressing.

> https://wnsp.io/spectral-search

Cross-layer search across nodes, agents, users, documents, and channels. Queries are CE-encoded to λ; results ranked by electromagnetic proximity and Shannon channel coherence.

## Hardware & Physics Lab

> https://wnsp.io/hardware-lab

Physics calibration verifier and live spectrometer for validating WNSP hardware against Maxwell equation constraints.

> https://wnsp.io/divergence-test

Dynamical system analysis — parameterized channel-dynamics engine demonstrating state-dependent routing, attractor classification, and regime prediction.

## Ecosystem & Governance

> https://wnsp.io/spectral-contracts

Physics-signed contracts — document signing using spectral wavelength keys (SHA-256(content) ⊕ hex(λ_signer)), replacing traditional PKI.

> https://wnsp.io/wnsp-bridge

TCP/IP overlay for wnsp:// URIs, mapping Ψ channels to HTTP resources via the wnsp_registry.

## Developer Resources

Published open-source packages:
- npm: `nexusos-ce-encoder@1.0.0` (install: `npm install nexusos-ce-encoder`)
- Python: `pip install git+https://github.com/nexusosdaily-code/NexusOS#subdirectory=packages/ce-encoder-py`

Both expose `ceEncode(text) → { wavelength, band, psiChannel, energy }` with bit-identical output. AGPL-3.0.

## Key Equations

- Compression state: Λ = hf/c²
- WNSP channel density: D_WNSP = N_λ · N_OAM · N_Pol · R_sym · M  (51,200 orthogonal channels)
- Physics fee: fee = base_fee × (E_sender / E_reference)
- Transaction energy: E = hf  (Planck relation)
- Spectral signing: SHA-256(content) ⊕ hex(λ_signer)

## Intellectual Lineage

Maxwell → Planck → Einstein → Tesla → Quantum Mechanics → Shannon → NexusOS. Every equation in the stack traces to one of these six foundational contributors.
